scenario: 平台约有 500M DAU，人工调查员每周只能确认约数百个账号的真值标签。
q: 这组规模和标注数字，对系统设计意味着什么？
why: 决定性约束是高流量和标签稀缺并存：计算必须省着花，训练和评估都要为少量高质量标签专门设计流程。
why_en: At this scale, compute is a hard budget and the whole pipeline—training, active labeling, evaluation—has to be designed around only a few hundred trusted labels a week.
options: 计算必须是硬约束，训练和评估要为标签稀缺专门设计（级联、主动标注、弱监督）
标签充足，可以直接用监督学习解决全部问题
规模足够小，可以对每个账号跑最贵的模型
标注慢没关系，反正 bot 数量可以忽略不计
options_en: Compute has to be a hard constraint, and training/evaluation must be designed around scarce labels (cascades, active labeling, weak supervision).
Labels are abundant, so pure supervised learning can solve everything directly.
Scale is small enough to run the most expensive model on every account.
Slow labeling doesn't matter because bot volume is negligible anyway.

q: 为什么说 bot detection 是一个对抗性（adversarial）问题？
why: 今天有效的频率/内容/IP 信号，明天可能被绕过；设计要偏向更难伪造的行为、图和时间模式。
why_en: Bot detection is adversarial because whatever signal catches bots today gets studied and evaded tomorrow, so design should lean on harder-to-fake behavioral and graph patterns.
options: bot 作者会持续观察系统并调整行为来逃避检测

获取新标签总是免费且即时的
检测系统上线不会引发任何博弈

scenario: 你要给 bot detection 定业务目标，不能只追求抓最多账号。
q: 更合理的业务目标是什么？
why: 决定性问题是谁承担代价：只追封禁数或 accuracy 都会激励误伤真实用户；guardrail 把体验伤害设成硬上限。
why_en: The objective should minimize bot impact on real users with a hard false-positive guardrail, because optimizing raw ban counts or accuracy alone rewards over-flagging legitimate accounts.
options: 最小化 bot 影响，设误伤上限
最大化封禁账号数量
最大化模型 accuracy
最小化人工审核数量，不管质量
whenOtherWins: 如果是已人工确认的 bot 批量清理，封禁数量可以作为执行指标而非设计主目标。
tradeoff: 抓 bot 的力度 vs 误伤真实用户的代价
options_en: Minimize bot impact, with a hard cap on false positives.
Maximize the number of banned accounts.
Maximize model accuracy.
Minimize how much manual review is needed, regardless of quality.
optionMeanings: 把目标定义成降低伤害，同时设误伤上限
把目标定义成纯粹的封禁数量
把目标定义成模型整体正确率
把目标定义成减少审核工作量本身

Defines the goal as raw ban count.
Defines the goal as overall model correctness.
Defines the goal as cutting review workload itself.
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Keeps fighting bots without sacrificing legitimate user experience.

q: 为什么“最大化模型 accuracy”不适合作为 bot detection 的业务目标？
why: bot prevalence 和真实用户体量都很大时，高 accuracy 仍可能对应大量误判，用户感受到的是垃圾内容和误封。
why_en: Accuracy is a poor objective here because with skewed class distribution, a high accuracy score can still hide millions of real misclassifications that users feel as spam or wrongful bans.
options: 类别分布严重偏斜，用户感受到的是垃圾内容和误封，不是 accuracy 数字
accuracy 根本无法计算

accuracy 能自动防住对抗性攻击

scenario: bot 分数中等但不确定，误封真实用户代价高。

whenOtherWins: 如果证据是高置信恶意行为且风险大，直接移除账号更合适。
tradeoff: 可逆的软动作 vs 一步到位的封禁

why: 已见过的 bot 签名可用监督/近邻高精度覆盖；不断出现的新模式需要异常检测去找 unknown unknowns。
why_en: Known bot signatures get high-precision supervised and nearest-neighbor coverage, while unsupervised anomaly detection is there to catch new patterns nobody has labeled yet.
